name: QuAC: Question Answering in Context
description: QuAC (Question Answering in Context) is a benchmark for conversational reading comprehension. It consists of interactive dialogs between a student who asks questions about an unseen Wikipedia section and a teacher who answers by extracting spans from the text and providing dialog flow feedback.

publisher.name: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI, Stanford University
